candidates.script: Mercury retrograde just started — today, November third — and it's sitting at thirteen degrees Scorpio, almost exactly on top of the Sun. candidates.video_title: 5 Planets Retrograde Right Now — One Just Started Today
candidates.video_description: Mercury, Venus, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune are all retrograde simultaneously as of November 3, 2026. Astrologers consider this a rare collective pause. Here's what each one is slowing down.
candidates.script: Five planets are retrograde right now — Mercury, Venus, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune — all moving backward at the same time. And Mercury just joined today, stationing retrograde in Scorpio through November thirteenth. In astrology, mass retrogrades like this signal a collective pullback: the universe forcing revision before forward motion. Venus is re-examining relationships, Saturn is stalling structure, Neptune is blurring direction. This isn't chaos — astrologers call it a mandatory reset. The question is what you're being asked to revisit.

candidates.topic: Moon in Virgo Waning Crescent — Precision Release
candidates.teaser: The Waning Crescent Moon is in Virgo right now — and astrologers say this is one of the most underrated moments to let something go.
candidates.video_title: Waning Crescent in Virgo — The Most Overlooked Moon Phase
candidates.video_description: The Moon is currently in Virgo at 6.5° in its Waning Crescent phase. Astrologers associate this placement with discernment, purging, and healing routines. Here's why this phase matters more than most people think.
candidates.script: Nobody talks about the Waning Crescent Moon — but they should. Right now the Moon is at six degrees Virgo, and in astrology this phase is considered the most powerful window for conscious release. Not dramatic Full Moon release — quiet, precise, Virgo-style cutting. What habit, what relationship dynamic, what story about yourself no longer holds up under honest scrutiny? With five planets retrograde pulling everything inward, this Moon is asking you to get specific about what you're done carrying.

candidates.topic: The Astrological 10th House — Career, Legacy, Public Image
candidates.teaser: Your birth chart has a house that tells astrologers exactly how the world sees you — and most people have never looked at it.
candidates.video_title: The 10th House — Your Reputation Is Written Here
candidates.video_description: The 10th House in astrology governs career, public reputation, authority figures, and legacy. It's ruled by Capricorn and Saturn, and whatever sign sits at its cusp tells astrologers a lot about your professional path and how others perceive you.
candidates.script: Your birth chart has twelve houses, and the tenth one is the most public thing about you — your career, your reputation, the legacy you're building whether you know it or not. It's ruled by Capricorn and Saturn, and the sign on its cusp, called the Midheaven, is what astrologers look at to understand how the world perceives you professionally. This isn't about your job title — it's about what you're remembered for. So what sign is sitting on your tenth house cusp?

candidates.video_title: Saturn + Neptune Both Retrograde in Aries — Once in a Lifetime
candidates.video_description: Saturn sits at 9° Aries retrograde and Neptune at 2° Aries retrograde simultaneously as of November 3, 2026. Astrologers describe this as a rare tension between structure and illusion playing out in the sign of new beginnings. Here's what it means.
candidates.script: Saturn and Neptune are both retrograde in Aries right now — and astrologers say that combination is genuinely rare. Saturn at nine degrees is demanding discipline and accountability. Neptune at two degrees is dissolving certainty and blurring boundaries. Both in the same sign, the sign that starts everything. In traditional astrology this is a battle between what's real and what you've convinced yourself is real. The retrograde motion means that battle is happening internally first. What are you building that might not survive honest scrutiny?
